com.launchdarkly.sdk.internal.http

Class HttpErrors

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.internal.http.HttpErrors

  • public abstract class HttpErrors
extends java.lang.Object
    Contains shared helpers related to HTTP response validation.

    This class is for internal use only and should not be documented in the SDK API. It is not supported for any use outside of the LaunchDarkly SDKs, and is subject to change without notice.

      • isHttpErrorRecoverable

        @Deprecated
public static boolean isHttpErrorRecoverable(int statusCode)
        Deprecated. Prefer classifyHttpFailure(int), which returns a FailureClass that lets the caller distinguish an extended-regime backoff signal from an ordinary transient failure. This boolean method treats false as "give up permanently", which does not fit callers that keep retrying regardless of classification.
        Tests whether an HTTP error status represents a condition that might resolve on its own if we retry.
        Parameters:
        statusCode - the HTTP status
        Returns:
        true if retrying makes sense; false if it should be considered a permanent failure

      • checkIfErrorIsRecoverableAndLog

        @Deprecated
public static boolean checkIfErrorIsRecoverableAndLog(com.launchdarkly.logging.LDLogger logger,
                                                                  java.lang.String errorDesc,
                                                                  java.lang.String errorContext,
                                                                  int statusCode,
                                                                  java.lang.String recoverableMessage)
        Deprecated. Prefer classifyAndLogHttpFailure(com.launchdarkly.logging.LDLogger, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) and classifyAndLogTransportFailure(com.launchdarkly.logging.LDLogger, java.lang.Throwable, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), which return a FailureClass that lets the caller distinguish an extended-regime backoff signal from an ordinary transient failure. This method treats a false return as "give up permanently", which does not fit callers that keep retrying regardless of classification.
        Logs an HTTP error or network error at the appropriate level and determines whether it is recoverable (as defined by isHttpErrorRecoverable(int)).
        Parameters:
        logger - the logger to log to
        errorDesc - description of the error
        errorContext - a phrase like "when doing such-and-such"
        statusCode - HTTP status code, or 0 for a network error
        recoverableMessage - a phrase like "will retry" to use if the error is recoverable
        Returns:
        true if the error is recoverable

      • classifyHttpFailure

        public static FailureClass classifyHttpFailure(int statusCode)
        Classifies an HTTP response by its status code. Returns FailureClass.UNEXPECTED for 401 / 403 and any other 4xx not in the NORMAL list; returns FailureClass.NORMAL for 400 / 408 / 429, 5xx, and any other status the SDK treats as a failure.
        Parameters:
        statusCode - the HTTP status code
        Returns:
        the classification

      • classifyTransportFailure

        public static FailureClass classifyTransportFailure(java.lang.Throwable t)
        Classifies a transport-level exception. TLS or certificate validation failures anywhere in the exception chain are FailureClass.UNEXPECTED; all other transport failures are FailureClass.NORMAL.
        Parameters:
        t - the transport-level exception
        Returns:
        the classification

      • classifyAndLogHttpFailure

        public static FailureClass classifyAndLogHttpFailure(com.launchdarkly.logging.LDLogger logger,
                                                     int statusCode,
                                                     java.lang.String errorContext,
                                                     java.lang.String willRetryMessage)
        Classifies an HTTP failure per classifyHttpFailure(int), logs it at the appropriate level, and returns the classification for the caller to act on. Unexpected classifications log at Error since they typically indicate a customer-side problem (invalid or expired SDK key, misconfiguration); normal classifications log at Warn since they are typically transient.
        Parameters:
        logger - the logger to log to
        statusCode - the HTTP status
        errorContext - a phrase like "in stream connection" or "on polling request"
        willRetryMessage - a phrase like "will retry" or "will retry at next scheduled poll interval"
        Returns:
        the classification

      • classifyAndLogTransportFailure

        public static FailureClass classifyAndLogTransportFailure(com.launchdarkly.logging.LDLogger logger,
                                                          java.lang.Throwable e,
                                                          java.lang.String errorContext,
                                                          java.lang.String willRetryMessage)
        Classifies a transport failure per classifyTransportFailure(Throwable), logs it at the appropriate level, and returns the classification. Unexpected classifications (TLS / certificate validation) log at Error since they typically indicate a customer-side problem (misconfigured trust store, expired cert); other transport failures log at Warn since they are typically transient.
        Parameters:
        logger - the logger to log to
        e - the transport-level exception
        errorContext - a phrase like "in stream connection" or "on polling request"
        willRetryMessage - a phrase like "will retry" or "will retry at next scheduled poll interval"
        Returns:
        the classification
